title: Migrate Docker/Podman to API-Owned Control Clients
task: Task 10 from the Bahia Platform Maturity plan
observed_behavior_before: Docker desired-state apply already had a RuntimeControlClient seam but Engine API mutation implementations still lived on DockerObserver in docker_apply.go.
Legacy Docker Deploy built create/start Engine API requests directly in docker.go instead of delegating mutating operations to the control client.
intended_behavior: Docker and Podman desired-state apply use an explicit DockerControlClient for find, ensure, pull, stop, remove, create, start, and network connect operations.
Docker-compatible Engine API mutation ownership lives in dockerEngineControlClient.
Apply results surface the RuntimeExecutionMode from the control client.
out_of_scope: Nostr protocol behavior; this task changes runtime adapter control flow only.
Deployment documentation changes; no user-facing deployment configuration changed.
